title: XXE injection runner: detect XML External Entity vulnerabilities in web applications and APIs
goal: WebGoat has a dedicated XXE lesson module and XXE is OWASP Top 10 (A05:2021 - Security Misconfiguration / A03:2021 - Injection). AegisPT has no XXE testing capability. Implement an xxe-probe runner that: (1) Discovers XML-consuming endpoints by identifying Content-Type: application/xml, text/xml, or endpoints with XML payloads in ZAP/httpx baseline results. (2) Sends crafted XXE payloads to each XML endpoint: basic XXE file read (<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM 'file:///etc/passwd'>), blind XXE using OOB callbacks (interactsh-compatible), and XXE via SVG upload if file upload endpoints exist. (3) For each response: check if the file content appears (direct), check for DNS/HTTP callback (blind). (4) Produces findings: 'XXE - File Read Possible (Direct)', 'XXE - Blind Out-of-Band Detected'. (5) Uses existing OOB callback infrastructure if present, or records the finding as 'potential - requires manual confirmation'. (6) Active tier tool — requires one approval. (7) ZAP active scan already has basic XXE checks (scanner ID 90023). Wire up the existing ZAP XXE scanner explicitly and add our own HTTP-layer probe as a complementary runner. Implementation follows the exact pattern of existing runners in workers/orchestration/tasks.py. WIZARD WIRING (mandatory — do not skip): Add a new RunProfile entry to api/app/services/run_profiles.py: { 'name': 'active-web-xxe-probe', 'run_class': RunClass.ACTIVE.value, 'limits_json': { 'description': 'Approval-gated XXE detection probe for XML-consuming web endpoints.', 'required_approvals': 1, 'approval_step_id': 'active-web-xxe-probe', 'tools': ['xxe-probe'], 'max_rps': 1, 'max_concurrency': 1 } }. Add 'active-web-xxe-probe' to FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB chain Phase 2 in api/app/services/assessment_chain.py alongside 'passive-web-nuclei-audit'. Add 'active-web-xxe-probe' to api-security tile Phase 2 in the same chain file. Wire wizard.js: in resolveExecutionProfile(), when assessmentType contains 'Website / Web App' or 'API' AND depth is 'active' or 'full', include 'active-web-xxe-probe' in the planned profiles list. Add to scripts/acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP: 'active-web-xxe-probe': ['xxe-probe'].
scope: Gap analysis 2026-05-03: WebGoat xxe module exists (github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat tree main/src/main/resources/lessons/xxe). AegisPT has no xxe runner or nuclei templates for XXE detection. OWASP lists XXE as critical. Burp Suite Pro detects XXE natively. This is a high-priority gap.
generation_reason: WebGoat has dedicated XXE module. AegisPT has no XXE testing capability — high-priority gap for web app assessment completeness.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement xxe-probe runner only. No payload delivery beyond file-read probes. No exploitation.
constraints.safety: XXE payloads must be read-only (file:///etc/passwd style). No billion laughs payloads that could crash targets. No SSRF via XXE to internal systems outside approved scope.
